// A damped spring between two anchor points: it exerts force
// -Stiffness * (length - RestLength) - Damping * lengthRate along the line
// between the anchors.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hooke%27s_law)
type SpringJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    RestLength: Length;
    Stiffness: Stiffness;
    Damping: DampingCoefficient;
}
